name: podz
caption:
PODZ 🎮🏀 1.4 points a game as a college freshman. Now he starts for us.

• Illinois: 16 games off the bench, 1.4 PPG, then he transfers
• Santa Clara: WCC co-Player of the Year
• 2023 draft: we take him at #19; All-Rookie 1st Team in 2024
• Played all 82 games last season
• First 8 games, all starts: 15.8 PPG, 5.4 RPG, 4.3 APG

Untouchable, or our best trade chip? 👇

facts.claim: Podziemski played 16 games off the bench as an Illinois freshman averaging 1.4 points, transferred to Santa Clara, WCC co-Player of the Year (2023), drafted 19th in 2023 by Golden State, NBA All-Rookie 1st Team (2024), appeared in all 82 games in 2025-26
